The devs have fruitlessly told me that some updates to the app have fixed my issue. They are just trying to save face. If the app doesn't crash over night, which it still does, it will sometimes simply decide on it's own to play no alarm at all. So stop reading these reviews and go get a physical alarm clock. You will find nothing in the way of consistency here. Which is the singular, sole purpose of an alarm existing in the first place... a particularly annoying and pathetic failure of an app.
